what_it_changes: When enabled, Glass shows a dismissible header tray (title "You're offline"; body warns sends fail until reconnect) on agent-panel bottom and prompt-input top while navigator.onLine is false; hook use-glass-offline-tray.react.js gates on va("glass_offline_tray") and browser online/offline events with per-episode dismiss. Bundled default false hides tray; desktop workbench is registry-only.
local_override: experimentService.setFeatureFlagOverride (dev builds, persisted TTL); remote Statsig gate
